text:
aditya: quick proposal — change rerank output to include an optional `score_bucket` (int) + header `X-Rerank-Score-Version: 2` for new clients. aim: make routing, billing, and telemetry cheaper/faster without breaking old clients. thoughts?

maya: curious — why `score_bucket`? how's that different from signed/normalized score we already have?

aditya: main idea: many consumers only need coarse ordering and a small "band" for confidence. `score_bucket` compresses float into a small integer so we can: (1) avoid sending float array (bandwidth), (2) compute inexpensive fanout and cost-estimates, (3) route by bucket -> model variant. also makes telemetry aggregation cheaper.

sam: sounds useful for cost math. what about compatibility? clients that read floats should keep working. clients that read ints will have to check header `X-Rerank-Score-Version`.

jordan: risk: clients that assume monotonic floats might break if we produce bucket collisions. We need a compatibility policy: if `score_bucket` present, also emit legacy `score` (float) for 3 releases, then deprecate in API docs.

aditya: agreed on dual-write during transition. plan: new runtime emits both. Console will default to showing `score_bucket` histograms under the "Rerank telemetry" panel, with an option to toggle float view.

maya: two operational asks: (A) quota accounting — bucketed responses should count differently? (B) SLO measurement — latency must include bucket compaction time.

aditya: (A) propose a soft token model: each candidate costs 1 token by default, but if `score_bucket` present and client opts in via header `X-Rerank-Billing: bucket` then we bill at 0.6 tokens/candidate for selected models. ops can override per-tenant. (B) compaction is ~1ms, included in p50. will add metric `rerank.bucket.compaction.ms`.

sam: ops concern: how does routing choose model variant from bucket? example: bucket=0 high relevance -> use fast-quantized. bucket=5 low -> fallback to small model. we need a clear affinity map plus safety thresholds.

aditya: propose routing table shape (console + API):
```json
{
  "bucket_to_variant": {
    "0-2": "gpt-rerank-xlarge-q4",
    "3-5": "gpt-rerank-large-q4",
    "6-10": "gpt-rerank-medium-fp16"
  },
  "fallback_order": ["gpt-rerank-large-q4","gpt-rerank-medium-fp16","gpt-rerank-small-cpu"]
}
```

jordan: need guardrails: if chosen variant is out of capacity, fallback must preserve ordering (i.e., re-score top-K only, not full fanout). Also add a per-tenant `fanout_budget` to avoid noisy tenants blowing throughput.

aditya: yes — console will expose `fanout_budget` slider per tenant (default 500 candidates/sec) + a global safety cap. If exceeded we degrade by truncation + async background rescore if tenant enabled.

maya: telemetry: we should surface drift when score_bucket distribution shifts vs baseline. request a metric set: `rerank.bucket.p50,p90,p99`, `rerank.signed_score.stdev`, `rerank.reorders_per_call` and an alert when top-1 change rate > 2% for a week.

sam: add trace correlations: track `route_variant` and `billing_mode` in traces + logs. console drilldown -> example requests -> show pre/post ordering diffs. :eyes:

jordan: rollout plan? we need canary + throttles. propose: 1) internal canary (5% traffic) for 24h, 2) customer opt-in beta, 3) auto-promote if errors<0.1% and emulation regressions <0.5% on holdout prompt set.
aditya: sounds good. I'll open a rollout PR. ops-bot: kick a canary deploy?

ops-bot: deploy request queued: rerank-service:v2026.4-canary -> env=staging (triggered by aditya). CI: 9/9 checks passed.

maya: one more UX note — in the console, when tenants opt into bucket billing, show projected monthly savings with toggle and an "impact preview" that simulates ordering differences on sample queries. customers asked for that in last sync.

aditya: noted. thanks everyone. i'll draft the API change doc + migration playbook and tag infra + billing for policy knobs.

jordan: ping me on the PR for capacity fallback logic. I'll add a simulation harness for partial fanout.

sam: i'll add telemetry dashboards and a cost dashboard tile. we should also publish a short note in #product about behavior changes.

aditya: thanks — will update thread when PRs land. :rocket:
